answer_1.quote: In the ranking challenges, LLMs have shown demonstrated performance. Research, such as RankGPT and PRP, highlights the proficiency of GPT models in delivering competitive ranking results, surpassing traditional neural ranking models in precision and relevance.
answer_1.outputs: ranked lists of articles based on relevance to a query

answer_2.quote: We measure how well LLMs integrate underrepresented groups into rankings, using group fairness for visibility and precision for utility.
automatic_metrics: Ratio of protected to unprotected group items ranked first

answer_3.quote: In the pairwise evaluation method, we delve into item-side fairness by presenting pairs of items to the LLMs, with one from the protected group and one from the non-protected group. This method includes two distinct tasks. Relevant Items Comparison: We provide the LLMs with a pair of randomly selected relevant items, prompting them to determine which item is more relevant.
